note: Provenance tiers: MEASURED_TABLE > DIGITIZED_FROM_PUBLICATION > APPROXIMATED_CURVE > CALCULATED > MODEL_PREDICTION > ILLUSTRATIVE > METADATA_ONLY

datasets.name: FLEX-2 n-Heptane Droplet — 21% O₂, 1 atm (Time-Series)
datasets.source_document: Nayagam et al., Combustion and Flame 159(12):3583–3588, 2012; Dietrich et al., NASA/TM-2014-218323
datasets.figure_or_table_reference: Figure 2 (D² vs time) and Figure 4 (phase transitions) in Nayagam 2012
datasets.license_attribution: Data reproduced for educational/demonstration purposes. Original data held by NASA Glenn Research Center. Cite Nayagam et al. 2012 and Dietrich et al. 2014.

column_provenance.time_s: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — uniform 0.1 s grid, not variable-interval digitised points
column_provenance.D_mm: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — constructed to match published K_hot ≈ 1.4 mm²/s and K_cool ≈ 0.3 mm²/s; not confirmed raw optical telemetry
column_provenance.flame_diam_mm: ILLUSTRATIVE — estimated at 3–4× droplet diameter; not a recorded measurement
column_provenance.temp_K: ILLUSTRATIVE — smooth profile consistent with phase transitions; not a thermocouple record
column_provenance.burn_rate_K_mm2_s: CALCULATED — finite differences of D2_mm2 with smoothing
column_provenance.phase: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — inferred from D_mm thresholds and published transition times
column_provenance.data_quality: column value is legacy label; see column_provenance for accurate tier

known_limitations: D(t) curve steps are uniform arithmetic sequences inconsistent with genuine digitisation scatter
Does not represent raw CIR/MDCA optical camera output
Qualitatively consistent with published findings but should not be cited as raw flight data
PSI-69 raw per-burn telemetry would replace this file — see DATA_NEEDED.md

datasets.name: SAFFIRE-I SIBAL Fabric — Large-Scale Fire (Time-Series)
datasets.source_document: NASA NTRS 20170008805 'Results of Large-Scale Spacecraft Flammability Tests' (Ferkul, Olson, Urban, Ruff et al.)
datasets.figure_or_table_reference: Table I (p. 29) and thermocouple figures; steady spread rate 1.8 mm/s and flame length 40 mm confirmed
datasets.license_attribution: NASA NTRS document 20170008805. Cite Ferkul et al. 2017.

column_provenance.time_s: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — time grid constructed from reported 420 s duration
column_provenance.flame_pos_cm: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — derived from published 1.8 mm/s spread rate; not independent digitised trace
column_provenance.flame_length_cm: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — steady-state plateau consistent with reported 40 mm; constant for 330 s is too smooth for raw thermocouple
column_provenance.flame_width_cm: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — ramps to full 40.6 cm width
column_provenance.spread_rate_cm_s: MEASURED_TABLE — 0.180 cm/s value from Table I; interpolated ramp-up is constructed
column_provenance.peak_temp_K: APPROXIMATED_CURVE — consistent with reported ~1630 K peak; precise trace not independently digitised
column_provenance.flame_power_W: MEASURED_TABLE — 1200 ± 300 W from Table I; time-variation pattern is constructed

known_limitations: Steady-spread region shows exact constant values (flame_length=4.0, spread=0.180) for 330 s — characteristic of constructed curve not raw thermocouple
PSI-98 raw sensor traces would replace this file — see DATA_NEEDED.md
Summary scalar values (Table I) are reliably sourced; time-series interpolation is not
